policy.developmentGate: Validate structure, evidence truthfulness, ownership, and deadlines without requiring every future release item to be complete.
policy.releaseGate: Every required item must be verified or explicitly waived with approval before a submission candidate may be called release-ready.

releaseCandidate.reason: Recovery headset proof and required Meta release obligations remain open.

requirements.title: Meta developer organization verified
requirements.nextAction: Verify the developer organization and record the dashboard evidence reference.

requirements.title: Meta app record and App ID created
requirements.nextAction: Create the dashboard app record and store the App ID through the project secret/configuration process; never commit a private credential.

requirements.title: Stable support page URL
requirements.nextAction: Publish a stable support page and record the HTTPS URL plus a dated accessibility check.

requirements.title: Stable Terms of Service URL
requirements.nextAction: Publish Terms of Service appropriate to the actual offline/online feature set and record the HTTPS URL.

requirements.title: Hosted privacy policy and deletion/contact path
requirements.nextAction: Publish a policy matching the proven data behavior, including Photon only if online functionality ships.

requirements.title: Meta Data Use Checkup completed and annual renewal tracked
requirements.nextAction: Complete the dashboard checkup, record the completion evidence, and schedule the next annual due date.

requirements.title: Age-group self-certification and IARC answers locked
requirements.nextAction: Lock the Mixed Ages path and complete IARC using the shipped content, not planned content.

requirements.title: Store art, screenshots, trailer, descriptions, and keywords conform
requirements.nextAction: Create the asset-production brief from the current Meta size/content rules after the visual vertical slice exists.

requirements.title: Release keystore owned, backed up, and used
requirements.nextAction: Create the release keystore outside the repository, document recovery custody, and prove APK signature scheme v2.

requirements.title: Release manifest, permissions, build flags, and architecture audited
requirements.nextAction: Create a release-only manifest/permission/size/ARM64 audit with a preserved report artifact.

requirements.title: Photon defines, demos, App ID, and licensing match the release feature set
requirements.nextAction: Keep release on hold until package license evidence is stored; decide defines-off and demo-strip behavior for the release pipeline.

requirements.title: Entitlement check executes within the required launch window
requirements.nextAction: After the Meta App ID exists, add the Platform SDK entitlement path and capture device evidence.

requirements.title: Pause, focus-aware rendering, input suppression, and audio behavior comply
requirements.nextAction: Implement only after recovery freeze release, then pass every doff and Universal Menu row on device.

requirements.title: Recenter behavior and sitting/standing/input metadata are truthful
requirements.nextAction: Resolve in the settings/height program after recovery, then prove on the supported-device matrix.

requirements.title: Head-tracked graphics or VR loading indicator appears within four seconds
requirements.nextAction: Measure a release-like cold boot on the oldest supported device and preserve timestamped evidence.

requirements.title: Sustained 72 Hz under release-build thermal load
requirements.nextAction: Run the twenty-minute thermal test and preserve RuntimeHealthMonitor/device evidence.

requirements.title: No data loss across interrupts, low storage, and update-over-install
requirements.nextAction: Run the broader post-recovery certification matrix and convert every failure into a tracked blocker.

requirements.title: Title/save, comfort settings, onboarding, credits, version, and release-safe diagnostics exist
requirements.nextAction: Build the player-facing shell after recovery; strip or lock DevMenu in release without deleting diagnostics.
